proposed_comments.title: Hide decorative overflow icons from UI Automation
proposed_comments.body:
### Hide decorative overflow icons from UI Automation

**Severity:** `medium`

The overflow command already exposes its title through the menu item, but this `IconBox` remains in the accessibility content view and can appear as a separate unlabeled UI Automation node. Mark the decorative icon as `AccessibilityView.Raw`, matching the inline shelf icon.

```suggestion
iconBox.SourceRequested += IconProvider.SourceRequested16;
Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetAccessibilityView(iconBox, Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.Peers.AccessibilityView.Raw);
```

confidence.rationale: The pinned code assigns the IconBox to the menu item without an accessibility-view setting, while the inline shelf icon uses Raw for the same decorative role. Runtime UIA enumeration remains unverified.

proposed_comments.title: Name the custom shelf landmark for assistive technology
proposed_comments.body:
### Name the custom shelf landmark for assistive technology

**Severity:** `medium`

`QuickAccessShelfSurface` declares a custom landmark, but its current `x:Uid` resources provide only `AutomationProperties.Name`. Add `LocalizedLandmarkType` for the same `x:Uid` so assistive technology receives the localized landmark type, matching the existing `Details` landmark.

```suggestion
  </data>
  <data name="QuickAccessShelfSurface.[using:Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation]AutomationProperties.LocalizedLandmarkType" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Quick access shelf</value>
  </data>
```

confidence.rationale: The pinned XAML declares a custom landmark and the same x:Uid resource has only a name; an existing Details landmark demonstrates the missing localized-type pattern. Screen-reader output remains unverified.
